findings: Material-only alpha-coverage correction did not restore coherent nape mass.
Close views retain sparse broken strands, exposed neck and an abrupt crown/root transition.
Ordinary rear view loses the source hair silhouette and coverage.
accepted_scope: The licensed MPFB guide/card/bake pipeline, raw protected source, corrected sRGB atlas and isolated head binding are useful source work only.
next_action: Stop before long motion/LOD. Inspect actual card UV/coverage and reuse a coherent underlying hair mass/source layer; preserve crown/body and both rejected native witness sets.
